    MulBasisNode from "only deep contours" #

    For a minimal representation-infinite distributive algebra B, BGRS §4 (adapted to mild algebras) gives a presentation whose path values vanish exactly on the zero paths of the ray category. If moreover every non-interlaced pair of paths with the same nonzero value is deep (OnlyDeepNode, Bongartz's "On mild contours", Theorem 3), BGRS 2.9–2.10 give a twisted multiplicative basis (mulBasisNode_of_onlyDeep).

      def LargeIndecomposable.OnlyDeepNode :
      Prop

      Bongartz, "On mild contours", Theorem 3, in the form needed here: in the ray category of a minimal representation-infinite distributive algebra, two non-interlaced paths with the same nonzero value have a deep value.

        def LargeIndecomposable.ScalarNode :
        Prop

        The proportionality node: for a minimal representation-infinite distributive algebra there is a zero-detecting lift for which every non-interlaced pair of paths with the same nonzero value is deep or has proportional values. This is what BGRS 2.9–2.10 need; OnlyDeepNode gives it with any zero-detecting normalized lift, and the degenerate penny-farthing and the closed dumb-bell (where contours need not be deep) are to be treated by an adapted lift.
